tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Wallet-based sign-in flow: request a nonce message, verify the signed message to obtain an access token, and fetch the current authenticated session.

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: Register a wallet address as a fundraiser or supporter account.

tags.name: Fundraiser Profile
tags.description: View and manage a fundraiser's own profile, and look up public fundraiser profiles.

tags.name: Fundraiser Campaigns
tags.description: Create and manage campaigns owned by the authenticated fundraiser.

tags.name: Supporter Profile
tags.description: View and manage a supporter's own profile and donation history.

tags.name: Public Campaigns
tags.description: Browse public campaigns and see who has donated to them.

tags.name: File Uploads
tags.description: Generate presigned URLs for uploading images to storage.

get.description: List campaigns owned by the authenticated fundraiser. Search matches titles and short descriptions case-insensitively.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

403.description: The authenticated wallet is not a registered fundraiser.

422.description: One or more query parameters are invalid.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while listing campaigns.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against the campaign title or short description.

post.description: Persist a campaign deployment intent before the backend relayer creates its child contract. goalAmount uses atomic USDC units (6 decimals). Reusing the same Idempotency-Key with the same normalized payload returns the existing campaign.

201.description: Campaign persisted with pending deployment status.

400.description: Missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or malformed request body.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

403.description: The authenticated wallet is not a registered fundraiser.

404.description: The fundraiser profile no longer exists.

409.description: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different payload.

422.description: One or more campaign fields are invalid, including an endAt less than five minutes in the future.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque, case-sensitive key scoped to the authenticated fundraiser; 1-255 bytes.

endAt.description: Must be at least five minutes in the future.

get.description: List publicly visible campaigns. Only campaigns with deployed contracts are returned. Search matches titles and short descriptions case-insensitively. Results are randomized when sortBy is omitted.

422.description: One or more query parameters are invalid.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while listing campaigns.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against the campaign title or short description.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Optional deterministic sort. Results are randomized when omitted.

get.description: Get a campaign owned by the authenticated fundraiser. The campaign ID is returned when a campaign is created, so pending campaigns without a contract address can also be retrieved.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token.

403.description: The authenticated wallet is not a registered fundraiser.

404.description: No campaign exists for the supplied ID that is owned by the authenticated fundraiser.

422.description: The campaign ID is not a valid UUID.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while retrieving the campaign.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Campaign UUID returned by the create campaign endpoint.

get.description: Get a deployed public campaign by its contract address. Contract address matching is case-insensitive.

404.description: No deployed public campaign matches the supplied contract address.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while retrieving the campaign.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Deployed campaign contract address. Matching is case-insensitive.

get.description: List donors for a deployed public campaign. Donations are grouped case-insensitively by wallet address; amount is the gross aggregate donated by that wallet and donatedOn is its latest donation time. Active supporter profiles enrich the optional name and imageUrl fields.

404.description: No deployed public campaign matches the supplied contract address.

422.description: One or more sorting or pagination parameters are invalid.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while listing campaign donors.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Deployed campaign contract address. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by the latest donation time or by gross aggregate donation amount.
